**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4467#issuecomment-7230485628

## Scope

- The diff changes `xtask/src/unit_env.rs` and adds `docs/decisions/4454-win-ui-config-path.md`.
- The diff does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation or geometry. This is not a safety-tier review.
- The diff does not change `crates/ui`. Screenshots are not necessary.
- The diff changes no `build.rs`, `scripts/`, `.github/` or dependency. `xtask/` is built locally.

## What looks good

- The cause is correct. On Windows, `Path::join("crates/ui")` keeps the `/`. `config::notes` then adds `.cargo` and the file name as separate components (`xtask/src/unit_env/config.rs:12`, `:38`). Thus the old note was `...\crates/ui\.cargo\config.toml`. With the fix, the production path and the test path have only native separators.
- The fix is one join in `plan_notes`. It also gives a clean native path in the note that the user reads.
- The source pin `plan_notes_join_the_ui_directory_by_components` cuts the `plan_notes` body and checks the join form. `.gitattributes` sets `eol=lf`, so the `"\n}\n"` split also works in a Windows checkout.
- The decision file records what was chosen, why, and what was dropped. It keeps #4427 and #4428 separate.
- The body has `Process change: yes`. The PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. The body has `Changelog: none` and ends with `Fixes #4454`. The commit subject is conventional.

## Results (locally, trial merge with upstream/main `6898b02ea319`)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 1 step (`xtask unit tests`), 0 failed, 167 s. 442 tests passed, 0 failed.
  - `unit_env::tests::plan_notes_join_the_ui_directory_by_components`: ok.
  - `unit_env::tests::plan_notes_only_scan_ui_config_for_ui_steps`: ok.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean. The `needless_bool` error in `unit_sweep.rs` that the body names is not on this main.
- Extra suites run: none apply. The diff changes no `testdata/`, fixture or golden, and no importer code.
- Heavy lanes: not run. No heavy lane covers `xtask/`.
- Goldens moved: none. The body says the same.

## Mutations (by the reviewer)

1. Put back `root.join("crates/ui")` in `plan_notes`: the pin failed (red). Restored.
2. Keep the fix and add a second `root.join("crates/ui")` in the `plan_notes` body: the pin failed (red). Restored.

## Not exercised

- No Windows host was available. The Windows check watcher of main must confirm the fix after the merge.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

- The pin reads the source text. It cannot see the Windows failure directly. This is acceptable because Linux and macOS cannot show the mixed separator.
